visual_text: Illustrative sequence, not a measured frequency
How a stopped medicine can come back
Next monthly order placed from the repeat list
Supply arrives with the stopped tablet
Repeat list and next order updated within days
Review of 54 studies: about half of adults had an unintended medicine discrepancy after leaving hospital (median of 11 studies).
alt_text: Diagram of how a stopped medicine can return. Without a check, a hospital stops a tablet but the GP repeat list stays unchanged and the next supply includes it. With a named person, the repeat list is updated and the supply matches the discharge letter. Review: about half of adults had a discrepancy.
design_instructions: Single card. Orange label Without a check: six boxes in 2 rows of 3 with arrows, GP repeat list box orange outline, tablet icon on last. Teal label With a named person: three teal boxes, tick on last. Mint strip with review figure. Claim C16-11-a. No people.
